turkey-law (public on GitHub, pinned 58fe0ce = main) holds 1,013 law-rank acts from mevzuat.gov.tr (908 kanunlar, 9 Ottoman-era, 63 KHK, 33 CBK), including the Constitution with the 2017 amendments and all nine essential codes, consolidated and current to amendments of August 2026 (retrieved 2026-10-28); 280 laws carry in-force history from the publisher's earlier texts, the other 733 are current text only. No case law is held, and the README, corpus.json and laws.csv still use the pre-2026-11-10 paths and call the public repository private.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
